scope: Declared design integrity, independent source witnesses, static paths, finite causal/time/reward/knowledge transactions. Not complete AI, mobile playtesting, all event combinations, physical receipt authentication or production persistence.

result.scope: Shared catalogs and preserved V0.4 history only; run validate_design_v05.py for current gameplay. Static/headless checks do not validate navigation, touch UI, phone performance or play balance.
Current design coverage, links, budgets and authored invariants. No full monster runtime, dynamic route or fun validation.

result.limits: Static four-neighbor tile paths with doors fixed at scenario start. No moving enemies, collision radius sweep, timing AI, field-of-view renderer, touch UI or arbitrary event combinations were simulated.

result.limitations: 仅静态格网、具名位置、局部路线、湿区割点、宽通道段和半径探针；不宣称客户端、60怪AI或所有事件组合已完成。

result.scope: core schema, explicit design invariants, references, and independent finite source-dependency witnesses
interpretation: Each of the 60 witnesses starts independently from NEW_SHIFT; they are not one playable night.
Operators represent declared concrete action/instance sources. A witness is only as truthful as those authored source contracts.
Facts invalidated by an action are removed before its products are added; the witness is replayed from its seed.
Each named operator is used at most once per witness. A second item/order/batch requires its own named instance operator.
Historical phase checks compare only explicit known metadata; they do not simulate elapsed time, observation continuity, or omen scheduling.

SAFE_ROUTE and SUPPLIES are abstract admission claims. This report does not prove collision/navigation, shared inventory quantities, deadlines, all event combinations, complete AI, guaranteed success, or fun.
SEARCH_LIMIT is inconclusive and fails validation; only an exhausted finite search is reported as UNREACHABLE.
F14 is included for design-source coverage while remaining disabled as a runtime candidate.
